title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend (Java, Spring Boot)
description:
**Job Description**  

We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on **Senior Software Engineer** to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.


You will work with engineers, product managers, architects, security specialists and business stakeholders to improve Customer Identity and Access Management capabilities across Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.


This is a long\-term strategic role with strong ownership. Over time, there will be opportunities to take broader technical leadership responsibilities within the team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.


Key responsibilities include:

* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop and improve customer identity journeys, including registration, sign\-in, password reset, account recovery, multi\-factor authentication and social login.
* Integrate backend services with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID and other customer identity platforms.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and token\-based security.
* Build reliable APIs and integrations for customer profile, consent, newsletter and related customer capabilities.
* Protect customer and personal data through secure design, access controls, privacy\-aware data handling and appropriate operational controls.
* Design services for scalability, reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Improve observability through effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and alerts.
* Own services across the full lifecycle, including automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Investigate technical issues and production incidents, identify root causes and implement long\-term improvements.
* Collaborate with security, architecture, product and engineering teams to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Review code, support engineering standards, mentor colleagues and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs clearly.
* Contribute to the future evolution of the CIAM landscape, including the adoption of new identity platforms such as Strivacity.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**


The CRONUS Platform Team is part of Portfolio Brands Tech and supports the digital commerce platform used by Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. The team owns shared platform capabilities that help the brands deliver stable, secure and reliable customer experiences.


The Platform Team works across five capability areas:

* **Backend Engineering:** Shared backend services and system\-to\-system integration services.
* **Site Reliability Engineering:** Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.
* **Automation:** Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.
* **Operations:** Incident management, problem management and platform stability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Security engineering, audits and compliance.


You will work mainly within Backend Engineering and the Identity module, while collaborating closely with SRE, operations, automation, security and other product teams. The team values end\-to\-end ownership, open communication, shared learning and practical solutions that improve customer experience and business reliability.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering and customer identity experience, along with a collaborative and ownership\-driven mindset.

* **Overall Experience:** 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.
* **Azure B2C:** Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus or similar technologies.
* Experience migrating between customer identity platforms or modernizing an existing CIAM solution.
* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.
* Experience working with customer consent, preference or newsletter capabilities.
* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.

**And people who are**

* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
* Curious and adaptable as technologies and identity platforms evolve.

**WHO WE ARE**

H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.


Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.


We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H\&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H\&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H\&M Incentive Program here.  

  

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

**JOIN US**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.


* *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: GeoSpatial Sr.Analyst MAP
description:
Job summary
  
GeoSpatial Senior Analyst MAP will design and enhance enterprise geospatial applications using Java and Net API within a hybrid work environment. The role focuses on advanced spatial data analysis system integration and performance optimization to support strategic business decisions improve operational efficiency and enable socially impactful location based solutions for global clients.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Analyze complex geospatial data sets and transform raw spatial information into actionable insights that support enterprise planning and operational decision making across multiple business domains.
  
Design and develop robust geospatial services using Java and Net API that enable reliable map visualization spatial querying and location intelligence features for internal and external applications.
  
Implement scalable spatial data processing workflows that optimize performance and accuracy of map related functions while maintaining high standards of data quality and governance.
  
Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate geospatial requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs that align with organizational objectives and digital strategies.
  
Configure and enhance existing mapping platforms to improve usability response times and functional coverage for users in different regions and business units.
  
Conduct detailed code reviews and technical assessments of Java and Net components to ensure adherence to coding best practices security guidelines and long term maintainability standards.
  
Coordinate with data engineering teams to define and refine spatial data models that support efficient storage retrieval and analysis of geo referenced information at enterprise scale.
  
Develop and maintain automated testing scenarios for geospatial services to ensure reliability of routing distance calculations proximity analysis and other spatial functions under varied data conditions.
  
Prepare comprehensive technical documentation for geospatial solutions covering architecture configuration details integration points and operational procedures to support seamless maintenance.
  
Engage with cross functional stakeholders to present geospatial findings and explain how spatial patterns influence customer behavior risk exposure and resource allocation decisions.
  
Monitor production geospatial systems in the hybrid work model and proactively resolve incidents or performance issues to maintain high service availability during day shift operations.
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that leverage advanced spatial analytics to reduce operational costs enhance sustainability efforts and generate measurable benefits for society and clients.
  
Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory expectations when handling location data by applying appropriate access controls anonymization practices and audit mechanisms.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess extensive experience in Java based application development with strong skills in building modular code and integrating complex geospatial logic into enterprise platforms.
  
Demonstrate deep expertise in Net API development including creation of secure services and interfaces that expose map related functions to diverse consuming applications.
  
Apply solid understanding of Net work model concepts to collaborate effectively within hybrid teams and deliver reliable solutions in a structured corporate environment.
  
Bring proven background in geospatial analysis tools and spatial databases supporting tasks such as layering buffering and spatial joins for business use cases.
  
Utilize strong knowledge of software engineering practices including version control unit testing and continuous integration to maintain high technical quality standards.
  
Show proficiency in consuming and producing map based services using industry standard protocols and formats to ensure smooth interoperability between systems.
  
Exhibit clear communication skills to explain complex spatial findings to nontechnical stakeholders and to document solution approaches in an accessible manner.
  
Apply analytical and problem solving capabilities to diagnose issues in data pipelines mapping services and client applications and to implement effective corrective actions.
  
Maintain awareness of emerging trends in geospatial technologies and spatial analytics to suggest enhancements that keep company offerings competitive and socially relevant.

title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

* Architecture \& System Design: Define and implement robust backend architectures aligned with best practices and business needs.
* Hands\-on Development: Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while contributing to testing, debugging, and optimization.

* Backend Excellence: Strong background in system design, architecture patterns, and distributed systems.
* Database Skills: Experience working with both NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Cloud Experience: Hands\-on exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Authentication \& Authorization: Working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML 2\.0, and JWT token lifecycle, plus institutional SSO with providers like Google Workspace or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Observability: Hands\-on with Open Telemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, distributed tracing, and defining SLIs and SLOs.

 **Nice to Have:*** Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or other container orchestration solutions.
* Experience with Pytest, Unittest, or similar testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Compliance and Governance:\*\* Exposure to GDPR, FERPA, or COPPA requirements, data residency constraints, consent management, and audit logging.
* Cost and Efficiency: Experience owning cloud spend, right\-sizing infrastructure, and tuning autoscaling for efficiency at scale.

* Data\-first culture with a strong focus on experimentation and learning
* Collaborative, transparent, and growth\-focused team environment

title: Lead Java Engineer
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a highly experienced **Lead Java Engineer** with 12–15 years of software development experience and strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, and high\-performance backend systems.


The ideal candidate should have deep hands\-on experience with **Java, Spring Boot, REST API development, database design, and backend integration**. The candidate will be responsible for designing robust backend solutions, developing enterprise\-grade services, integrating with internal and external systems, and providing technical leadership to engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services using **Java and Spring Boot**.
* Define and drive backend design principles, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Design and develop secure, reliable, and well\-structured **RESTful APIs**.
* Define API contracts, request/response models, error\-handling mechanisms, and versioning strategies.
* Design efficient and scalable **relational and/or NoSQL database models**.
* Develop and optimize database queries, indexing strategies, and data\-access layers.
* Integrate backend applications with databases, third\-party services, enterprise platforms, and external systems.
* Design and implement backend integration patterns for reliable data exchange across systems.
* Develop reusable backend components, libraries, and common services.
* Ensure backend systems meet requirements for **performance, scalability, availability, security, and maintainability**.
* Identify and resolve complex application, API, database, and integration\-related issues.

title: Microsoft D365 Associate Manager
description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  

  

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.


This is a foundational, build\-team senior development role with a mandate to anchor technical delivery leadership for our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Supply Chain practice in India. This is not a role designed to inherit a development team — it is being created to help establish one. From the X\+\+ style standards and code review discipline to the integration patterns, the Copilot Studio plugin library, and the AI build playbook, this role will help define the practice's technical craft from the ground up. You will own the build standard.  

Success in this role will require advanced X\+\+ fluency, real integration architecture credibility, and hands\-on experience shipping AI\-augmented components — Copilot Studio plugins, Azure OpenAI integrations, or comparable. The senior consultant in this position must be equally comfortable leading a code review for a Technical Consultant and architecting a Copilot Studio plugin from scratch — bringing both engineering craft and AI build credibility to every workstream they lead. The role calls for a developer who takes pride in code other people enjoy inheriting and treats AI engineering as a first\-class discipline alongside core development skill.  

The ideal candidate brings a minimum of 7 years in enterprise development with at least 4 on Microsoft Dynamics AX or D365 F\&O X\+\+, two or more years operating at Technical Consultant level, and at least three full lifecycle implementations including one as development lead. An active GitHub portfolio and at least one shipped engagement involving Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, or comparable AI integration is weighted heavily during selection. This individual is on a deliberate development track toward Technical Architect, with practice sponsorship for certifications, AI build time, and growing external visibility. Ultimately, this role calls for a senior consultant who is equal parts X\+\+ craftsman, integration architect, AI builder, and code\-review coach, with the appetite to grow into the architect chair through evidenced ship\-it discipline.**Requirements:*** Lead the development workstream on D365 F\&SCM engagements — owning X\+\+ extensions, custom services, data entities, and complex integrations end\-to\-end.
* Design and build Copilot Studio plugins, Azure OpenAI components, and AI\-powered F\&O extensions that move client outcomes — not science\-project work.
* Own integration design and build across Dual\-write, virtual entities, OData, custom services, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
* Run code reviews as a teaching tool — including AI\-generated code review discipline that catches the silent technical debt GitHub Copilot can introduce.
* Partner with the Functional team to translate functional design into technical design — and push back where the functional design has missed a technical implication.
* Drive Azure DevOps hygiene — branching strategy, automated builds, release pipelines, LCS asset management, and test automation.
* Mentor Technical Consultants through paired build, code reviews, and a structured development plan toward Sr. Technical Consultant.
* Build and contribute to the practice's technical IP library — accelerators, extension templates, integration patterns, and AI build references.
* Lead technical due diligence on pursuit\-stage discovery — integration discovery, infrastructure sizing, and AI build effort estimation.
* Own performance, security, and code\-quality remediation across the build phase — not as a final\-week scramble.
* Lead cutover technical activities — data migration runs, integration cutover, and post\-cutover stabilization.
* Represent the practice externally — Microsoft community contributions, internal brown\-bags, and (for top performers) external speaking opportunities
**Preference:**

* 9\+ years experience in enterprise development with 4\+ years in D365 F\&O (X\+\+).
* Minimum 2 years as Technical Consultant on D365 F\&O.
* Delivered 3\+ full lifecycle implementations, including one as Lead Developer/workstream owner.
* Exposure to AI integrations (Copilot Studio/Azure OpenAI) strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field; GitHub portfolio is a plus.
* Mandatory certifications: MB\-500, MB\-300; AZ\-204 (preferred/in progress); AI\-102 within 6 months.
* Strong expertise in X\+\+ development (extensions, CoC, performance tuning).
* Experience in integration architecture (OData, APIs, Service Bus, Azure Functions, Logic Apps).
* Proficiency in Azure services (App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID).
* Hands\-on with DevOps (Azure DevOps, CI/CD, LCS, automated builds/testing).
* Strong knowledge of data integration \& entity design for large\-scale systems.
* Experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, connectors).
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, and data lakehouse patterns.
* Strong focus on security, compliance, and testing discipline.
* Capability to build and manage AI solutions (Copilot plugins, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI Builder).
* Contribution to AI/engineering IP, reusable components, and code reviews with AI governance.
* Strong soft skills: code quality mindset, coaching ability, collaboration across geographies, and architectural understanding.

title: Software Development Engineer II, TFS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


If you are looking for high impact, high growth opportunity with interesting engineering challenges in a fast\-paced environment, this is the role for you. We have a number of untapped high impact engineering and business opportunities with high criticality for Amazon. And have the opportunity to work on the leading technologies like AI/ML, Gen\-AI, RAG and various AWS systems.
  

  

What will you own?  

You will work across a suite of products that drive complex business and engineering logic for managing financial accounting for \~$100B annual spend. These solutions leverage various AWS technologies and AI capabilities to solve large\-scale complex problems. The systems demand non\-trivial engineering, requiring deep business understanding and strong technical acumen. You will collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to identify opportunities for improving accuracy, expanding the solution across multiple geographies, and defining the technical roadmap while influencing solutions and tech decisions across teams.
  

  

Who we are?  

We, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) are responsible for building technologies that support financial aspects for Amazon transportation. Amazon’s transportation systems get millions of packages to customers worldwide faster and cheaper while providing world\-class customer experience – from checkout to shipment tracking to delivery. Our software systems include services that handle tens of thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted for. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, delivery models and customer experience, increasingly complex transportation network, ever\-expanding selection of products and growing number of shipments worldwide, we have an opportunity to build software that scales not only with volume but also with the business models. We leverage advanced technologies including big data, Gen\-AI, machine learning, real time analytics and high volume, low latency, high availability services.  

  

TFS is 100\+ tech team across eight different platforms. We deal with problems of scale. Billions of dollars of spend is automated through our platforms and pipelines. We are a growing org and we are looking to ramp up our team across all engineering roles. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with our global product teams and customers across the world and other tech teams in the organization as we raise the bar in delivering innovation.  

Our engineering team is completely based out of India, and we build global solutions.  

  

We have a large product and tech roadmap and are significantly ramping our tech team to meet the next level of product requirements for Trans Finance.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* The Engineer in this job is expected to make the design (High level and Low level) decisions, own end to end (depth) for specific set of features while having breadth on rest of the features and provide technical guidance for the Junior members in the team.
* Design and implement scalable solutions using Scala or Java, and AWS services
* Mentor team members and collaborate across functions to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive continuous improvement through code quality, testing, and technical debt reduction
* Provide hands\-on development for complex features while maintaining engineering excellence.

  

A day in the life  

Please reach out to avinayam@ for any further details.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

With a sole purpose of Making Everyone Who Touches Tally, Happier, we aim to be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world, by 2030\.


**Culture \& Values**
Over the years, we have nurtured a value\-based culture that let individuals follow their lead and support them in their growth journey with us. We value honesty and integrity, prioritize a people\-first culture, pursue excellence, and drive impactful innovation with simplicity.  

Our vision at Tally is to ensure that all employees get access to equal opportunities, with decisions grounded on performance, merit, competence, and potential. We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in our policies. By fostering diversity and equality, we strive to eliminate all forms of discrimination. We are committed to an inclusive leadership where our leaders ensure that our people are empowered to be at their best, professionally, and personally. We take great pride in our work culture which has helped become a proud member of the elite Kincentric Best Employers Club!


**Engineering:**
Our Engineering centre is located in Bangalore while our sales offices and partners are spread across the country and specific regions outside India. Our Engineering team consists of highly talented engineers who live a purpose and dream to develop the software that will accomplish our goal ‘To be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world’.


To build this network of businesses Tally likes to build its own technology stack to deliver the required products. Major components of the stack are highlighted below.


* **Operating system: We use a trimmed\-down version of the Linux**
* **Database system**: An Object\-oriented database written by Tally to support single view, replication, distributed and multi\-tenancy.
* **Web server \& app server:** We shall write our own hosting platform that can handle millions of connections per server.


Engineering @ Tally is responsible for the Design, Development \& Testing of all the delightful and flawless products that we release for our customers. We at Engineering do deep technology innovation to deliver unique experiences and capabilities at scale for simplifying business operations across sectors and segments.


### **We believe in**


* **Innovate:** Build our tech stack with purpose\-driven engineers to craft robust, scalable products that power economic growth.
* **Design for the future:** Lay the foundation of technology that connects businesses, enabling seamless growth and transformation.
* **Engineer the Core:** Create resilient, and secure software systems that form the backbone of our mission to drive global prosperity.


**What You Will Own**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Backend Lead to join our AI team. As a Backend Lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the performance, scalability, and efficiency of our backend architecture while mentoring and leading a team of engineers. This position requires deep expertise in backend engineering, particularly in Python, and a strong understanding of building scalable and efficient systems. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leadership in backend development, and the ability to drive complex technical initiatives.


**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future**
* Strong understanding of STLC, Agile and modern Quality Engineering practices, with expertise in functional, integration, API, regression, end to end, non\-functional testing and compatibility testing.
* Ability to analyse requirements and system workflows, design effective **test strategies, test scenarios, and risk\-based test cases**, and ensure comprehensive functional and non\-functional coverage.
* Hands\-on automation experience with Playwright/Selenium/Cypress and proficiency in Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Strong API and performance testing experience using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, Gatling or k6\.
* Good understanding of microservices, distributed systems, networking, databases and cloud\-native architectures.
* Hands\-on exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based workflows.
* Experience with observability, debugging and RCA using logs, metrics and monitoring tools such as Grafana, CloudWatch or ELK.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted testing/development and testing of AI/LLM\-based applications is an added advantage.
**The Scope of Your Influence*** **End\-to\-End Deployment \& Testing:** Collaborate with backend engineers to deploy models via Docker/Kubernetes, and design end\-to\-end test strategies (on\-prem and cloud) grounded in system architecture.
* **CI/CD \& Automation:** Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines and drive continuous test automation to minimize turnaround time for new releases.
* **Research \& Distillation:** Actively research state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models (e.g., Qwen3, Mistral) and apply Knowledge Distillation to create smaller, faster proprietary models.
* **Monitor \& Improve:** Continuously monitor drift, hallucination rates, and retrieval quality in production systems.
* **Code Quality and Best Practices:** Ensure that code adheres to best practices, including clean code principles, testing, and documentation.
* **Build Agentic Systems:** Implement multi\-agent workflows using LangGraph to solve complex, multi\-step user queries.
* **Optimize for Scale:** Implement Quantization and vLLM/SGLang strategies to reduce inference costs and latency in production.
